description: This file defines a class 'Cod' that extends the base controller in the OpenCart framework, specifically for handling Cash on Delivery (COD) payment method operations such as displaying the payment option and confirming the order.

classes.name: Cod
classes.description: A controller class for handling the Cash on Delivery payment method within the OpenCart platform, managing actions like displaying the payment option and confirming the order.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language resources, prepares data, and returns the view for the COD payment option during checkout.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Handles the order confirmation process by validating session data and updating order status, then returns a JSON response with success or error information.
